mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_eval_run ( run_id, suite_name, dataset_version, agent_commit, model_version, judge_version, judge_prompt_version, status, started_at, finished_at, total_cases, success_cases, avg_tokens, p95_tokens, avg_duration_ms, p95_duration_ms, avg_quality_score, summary_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{suiteName}, #{datasetVersion}, #{agentCommit}, #{modelVersion}, #{judgeVersion}, #{judgePromptVersion}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'RUNNING'), #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, COALESCE(#{totalCases}, 0), COALESCE(#{successCases}, 0), #{avgTokens}, #{p95Tokens}, #{avgDurationMs}, #{p95DurationMs}, #{avgQualityScore}, COALESCE(#{summaryJson, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_eval_run SET status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), finished_at = COALESCE(#{finishedAt}, finished_at), total_cases = COALESCE(#{totalCases}, total_cases), success_cases = COALESCE(#{successCases}, success_cases), avg_tokens = COALESCE(#{avgTokens}, avg_tokens), p95_tokens = COALESCE(#{p95Tokens}, p95_tokens), avg_duration_ms = COALESCE(#{avgDurationMs}, avg_duration_ms), p95_duration_ms = COALESCE(#{p95DurationMs}, p95_duration_ms), avg_quality_score = COALESCE(#{avgQualityScore}, avg_quality_score), summary_json = COALESCE(#{summaryJson, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, summary_json) WHERE run_id = #{runId}
